home.hero.title: Server activity — finally readable.
home.hero.subtitle: Profiles, graphs, leaderboards, economy and privacy — in one bot. No corporate tone. Just useful stuff.
home.hero.b1: Charts for messages + voice, any period
home.features.title: What Wolium can do
home.features.subtitle: I’m not trying to look “huge”. I’m trying to look useful. Here’s the stuff you’ll actually feel in daily usage.
home.feature.profile.title: User profiles that actually tell something
home.feature.profile.text: Avatar, status, level, XP, money, messages, voice time — plus server details if available.
home.feature.profile.b1: View your profile or someone else’s
home.feature.charts.title: Charts with message preview
home.feature.charts.text: Pick any time range. Tooltip shows a message preview, click opens it in Discord.
home.feature.leaderboard.title: Leaderboards for literally everything
home.feature.leaderboard.text: Total money, bank, cash, XP, level, messages, voice time, votes, vote streak — global or server.
home.feature.tools.title: Tools (not only “fun commands”)
home.feature.tools.text: Message translation, link redirect tree, number formatting, holidays, reports, message auto-delete (TTL).
home.feature.privacy.title: Privacy controls baked in
home.feature.privacy.text: You control what is stored. /delete_data removes saved messages and voice activity permanently.
home.feature.ai.title: AI tools
home.feature.ai.text: AI moderation/automation exists, but it’s still evolving. I’m improving it step by step — without overpromising.
home.feature.ai.b2: Future: natural-language control for bot actions
home.why.title: Why this bot
home.why.subtitle: A bot can have 200 commands and still be useless. Wolium is built around “daily value”.
home.why.i1.title: Dashboard, not a spreadsheet
home.why.i1.text: UI is part of the product: charts, profiles, tooltips, quick navigation.
home.why.i2.title: Updates without pain
home.why.i2.text: New features show up fast (often without a bot restart).
home.why.i3.title: Community-first
home.why.i3.text: Ideas from users aren’t “noted”, they actually get implemented.
home.why.i4.title: Localization
home.why.i4.text: Bot supports 25 languages. Site supports RU/EN/ES/UA (you can contribute!).
home.why.i5.title: Privacy by design
home.why.i5.text: You decide what data is stored. You can delete it.
home.why.i6.title: Made by one dev since 2021
home.why.i6.text: No “corporate bot”. Just a long-running project that keeps improving.
home.cta.title: Ready to try it on your server?
home.cta.text: Add Wolium, play with profiles and charts, and tell me what to improve next.
